body:
## Motivation

MiniMax-H3 at full quality needs 20+ denoising steps. The community [`larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora`](https://huggingface.co/larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora) distills the model so **4–10 steps** produce usable T2VA on the native FL2VA base — a large latency win for serving.

Turbo keys already match native H3 naming; the blocker was a merge crash on fused 2D `lora_B` weights. This PR fixes that so users can run **`--num-inference-steps 4` or `8`**.

## Root Cause

`MergedColumnParallelLinearWithLoRA` assumed 3D stacked `lora_B` (`B[:, start:end, :]`), but H3 Turbo ships fused **2D** weights (e.g. `qkv_proj` `(21504, 64)`, `fc1` `(28672, 64)`), causing `IndexError` at merge.

**Fix:** keep the 3D path; add 2D per-section TP sharding in `runtime/layers/lora/linear.py`.

Most other LoRAs (Wan, HunyuanVideo) split Q/K/V into separate keys that `lora_pipeline` stacks to 3D — H3 Turbo’s native fused layout never hit the old slicer in CI.

## Experiments (4 vs 8 Steps)

Bench on `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3` FL2VA with [`larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora`](https://huggingface.co/larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora) (`minimax_h3_turbo_4step_ema_ckpt500.safetensors` preferred), 4 GPUs, 1344×768 / 5 s, `flow_shift=12`, `audio_flow_shift=3`, seed **1101**, `lora_scale=1.0`. Same LoRA and seed; only steps change (4 vs 8).

**Prompt:** *At night, while their owner sleeps in a bedroom, three cats march in loudly playing tiny brass instruments, then abruptly file out.*


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/106de712-4f9c-4930-ac9d-878d1eafc29f


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5c4b43a9-ba75-4589-b049-eec0a4eeb4d6


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/40de65c5-88d0-478f-a601-8d73c821f0a3



| Steps | Effect (qualitative) |
|-------|----------------------|
| **4** | Scene coherent; softer detail, more motion blur |
| **8** | Same composition; sharper subjects and cleaner edges |

Turbo LoRA targets **usable few-step output vs. broken base@4-step**, not 20-step base parity. Prefer **ckpt500 + 4 steps** for speed; use **8 steps** when quality matters more.



## Example
```bash
sglang generate \
  --model-path MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 --model-variant fl2va \
  --lora-path larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora \
  --lora-weight-name minimax_h3_turbo_4step_ema_ckpt500.safetensors \
  --lora-scale 1.0 \
  --num-inference-steps 4 \
  --flow-shift 12.0 --audio-flow-shift 3.0 \
  --seed 1101
```

## ComfyUI LoRAs (Not Supported)

Community LoRAs like **[H3-GalaxyAce](https://civitai.com/models/2200329/galaxyace-lora?modelVersionId=3201619)** (Civitai) target the **ComfyUI pruned** graph, not SGLang’s native FL2VA:
| | SGLang native | ComfyUI pruned |
|--|---------------|----------------|
| Timestep → adaln | `SiLU(t_emb)`, **2688-d** | `adaln_t_table`, **8-d** |
| GalaxyAce `adaln_proj.lora_A` | `(32, 8)` ✗ | `(32, 8)` ✓ |

Partial loading (~416/516 keys) drops the adaln style path and is not equivalent to ComfyUI.
